items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: I have to go back to Don Redman, too, that taught me how to play with a section.

ctx.x: Let me ask you, how did you, how did the name Butter -- how did you get that name?
Oh, Don Redman when I first joined McKinney's Cottonpickers, I was young and I looked tender, you know, --
